topic: Discussion regarding Brazilian assets and analytics
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on gathering specific data points related to a client in Brazil (Jcdd Brasil). These included the required number of roadside assets for measurement and details regarding implementation in São Paulo, such as the count of installed sensors and modeled screens, along with the time taken for installation. The discussion also touched upon access credentials and user permissions within an analytics system.
action_items: Follow up on data requirements for roadside assets in Brazil
Determine sensor/screen counts and installation timelines for São Paulo implementation
